overview: The board reviewed several residential dimensional relief and special permit petitions, focusing heavily on evaluating municipal interests and dimensional standards for protected accessory dwelling units under state law. Decisions included approving dormer and dimensional relief for two ADUs, granting a variance and special permit for a single-family home expansion, approving a special permit to demolish and rebuild a three-family dwelling, and granting a permit extension for a mixed-use development.

items.title: 226 Main Street
items.summary: Continued the hearing on a proposed three-story, three-unit townhouse dwelling to December 3, 2026, at the applicant's request.

items.title: 590 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved a two-year extension of the variance and special permit for the demolition of an existing gas station and construction of a five-story, 45-unit mixed-use building.

items.title: 1-3 Vassar Street
items.summary: Approved a site-specific finding granting dimensional relief for a reduced 780-square-foot protected accessory dwelling unit, determined a variance was not required under state law, and granted a special permit to vertically extend the nonconforming side yard plane.

items.title: 12 Wellesley Street
items.summary: Approved a site-specific finding granting dimensional relief for a reduced 769-square-foot protected accessory dwelling unit with dormers, ruling that a variance was not required.

items.title: 11 Albion Street
items.summary: Approved a variance allowing 640 square feet of livable space on the third floor of a single-family home and approved a special permit to extend the nonconforming side yard setback vertically for a dormer.

items.title: 75 South Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to demolish an existing deteriorated nonconforming three-family dwelling and construct a new three-story, three-family residential building.
